errors.description: The final characterization is false without restricting d to primes appearing initially: any new prime q has exponent 1 dividing all zero initial q-valuations, so d can be enlarged by q indefinitely.
errors.quote: the unique maximal $d$ with $v_p(d) \mid v_p(a_i)$ for all $p$ and all $i$

parsed.notes: The actual proof of both parts is complete and correct. The only issue is an unnecessary, easily repaired concluding remark; restrict d to the support of the initial numbers or delete the remark.
